meta.title: About us | AZAFCO International, Egyptian fish since 2008
meta.description: Founded in 2008, AZAFCO International farms, sources, packs and exports fresh Egyptian fish to 7+ markets, with 2,500 t/month packing capacity.

hero.title: About AZAFCO International: fish farming, sourcing, packing and export in Egypt
hero.intro: Founded in 2008, we farm and source fish in Egypt, then wash, ice, grade, pack and inspect it, and export it fresh to importers, distributors and foodservice buyers across the Middle East and beyond.
hero.image_alt: Two workers pulling a seine net full of fish to the bank of an earthen pond

glance.title: AZAFCO International at a glance
glance.activity_value: Farms and sources fish, then packs and exports it whole and fresh chilled.
glance.species_value: 12 main species: {species}. Other species on request.
glance.capacity_value: Up to 2,500 t/month. A refrigerated truck carries 20 t, and on some days more than five leave the plant.
glance.certificates_value: Holds ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.

footprint.title: Our plant, trucks and cold stores
footprint.p1: Our fish processing and packing plant is in the Industrial Zone of Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, in Egypt's Nile Delta. Here we receive the fish, then wash, ice, grade, pack and inspect it before it is loaded for dispatch.
footprint.p2: We run our own refrigerated trucks, cold stores and logistics, from the plant to air or road freight.
